game_text_lines: At start of your turn, may draw a card from top of Reserve Deck for each Kashyyyk site where all your ability is provided only by Wookiees.
dark_text_lines:
Unless Mosep on table, Force lost from your Force drains here must come from hand, if possible.
While opponent has less than 13 cards in hand, Wookiees are immune to Monnok.
